question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

calls.reasoning: Recent cadence: Q1 FY27 $81.6B vs $78B guide, Q2 $96.2B vs $91B guide; next-quarter guides set ~11.5-14.5% above prior actual. Q3 guide $108B; a typical 3-6% beat gives Q3 actual ~$111-115B, and a 9-15% step implies a Q4 guide of ~$122-133B, centred ~$126B. Supply constraints are stated through FY28, Rubin is ramping (~20% of Q3 DC), and consensus Q4 revenue is ~$124.5B (range 117-138); NVIDIA guides have tended to land at or above consensus. Markets: no matching market; Polymarket has only thin, inconsistent Q3 Data Center revenue ladders (e.g. >$105B at 0.25 vs >$110B at 0.23, volume <$1k), a different quantity, used as weak evidence of a modest Q3 beat.
sources: Polymarket Q3 Data Center revenue ladder (harness-provided)
